name: vtc-aeroport-paris-transferts
description: Fixed-price private chauffeur and airport transfers in Paris (CDG, Orly, Beauvais, Le Bourget): instant quotes and bookings from vtc-aeroport.fr.

interface.longDescription:
Get the exact fixed price of a private chauffeur transfer in Paris and the Île-de-France region, then book it in the conversation.

VTC AEROPORT PARIS is a licensed private-hire (VTC) company operating since 2016. It drives travellers between Paris and Roissy-Charles-de-Gaulle (CDG), Orly, Beauvais and Le Bourget airports, train stations, hotels and Disneyland Paris, in economy cars, executive sedans, 7-seat vans and limousines.

What you can do:
- Compare vehicles by passenger and luggage capacity.
- Confirm a precise pickup or drop-off address.
- Get the fixed price of each vehicle for a given date and time (Paris time). Prices are the same as on vtc-aeroport.fr: no surcharge, no meter.
- Book the ride after you have reviewed and approved the summary (route, time, vehicle, price). Pay the driver on board by card or cash, or pay online through a secure link on vtc-aeroport.fr.
- Check the status of an existing booking with its number and your e-mail address.

Limitations: service area is Paris and Île-de-France (plus long-distance rides quoted on the website). Bookings cannot be cancelled or modified from ChatGPT: call +33 6 42 24 92 47. For an immediate departure, please call.
defaultPrompt: How much is a private transfer from CDG airport to the Eiffel Tower next Friday at 10am?
Which vehicle fits 6 passengers with 6 suitcases from Orly to Disneyland Paris?
Book me a chauffeur from my hotel in Paris to Orly airport tomorrow at 7am.

positive.description: Fixed-price quote between an airport and central Paris
positive.prompt: How much is a private transfer from Paris-Charles de Gaulle airport to the Eiffel Tower next Friday at 10am for 2 people with 2 suitcases?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the fixed price of each available vehicle (economy, sedan, van, limousine) in euros, with pickup time shown in Paris time. Prices match the website calculator (CDG to central Paris starts at 55 EUR). No booking is created.

positive.prompt: We are 6 people with 6 large suitcases. Which vehicle should we book for a transfer from Orly airport to Disneyland Paris?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists vehicles with passenger and luggage capacity, recommends the van (up to 7 passengers), and gives its fixed price for the route.

positive.prompt: I need a pickup at Hotel Le Bristol in Paris. Can you find the exact address?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one or more complete address suggestions (e.g. 112 Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré, 75008 Paris) and asks the user to confirm the right one.

positive.description: Booking with payment on board, after explicit approval (test mode)
positive.prompt: Book an economy car from Gare de Lyon, Paris to Orly airport in two weeks at 9am. Name: Alex Review, e-mail alex@example.com, phone +33 6 00 00 00 00, flight AF1234, I will pay the driver by card.
positive.tools_triggered: calculer_prix, then reserver (only after the user approves the summary)
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT first shows a summary (route, date and time, vehicle, fixed price, payment on board) and asks for explicit confirmation. After the user says yes, reserver returns a booking number. Because the e-mail uses the reserved example.com domain, the booking is recorded as a test booking and is not sent to a driver.

positive.prompt: What is the status of my booking? Use the booking number from the previous step and the e-mail alex@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the booking status (test booking, not dispatched), route, pickup time and total price. With a wrong e-mail, it answers that no booking matches.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Paris to New York next week.

negative.description: Booking without the user's approval or required details
negative.prompt: Just book any car from CDG to Paris right now, make up a name and phone number, don't ask me anything.
Book a limousine from Orly to Paris but charge me only 20 euros.

review.commerce_description: The plugin books a real-world transport service (private chauffeur rides) at the fixed prices published on vtc-aeroport.fr. No payment is taken inside ChatGPT: the customer either pays the driver on board (card or cash) or pays on vtc-aeroport.fr through an external checkout link. No digital goods, subscriptions or credits are sold.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: vehicle list, address suggestions, fixed-price quotes, bookings with payment on board or online, and booking status. No account needed.

fr-FR.subtitle: Transferts aéroport à Paris
fr-FR.description:
Obtenez le prix fixe exact d'un transfert en chauffeur privé à Paris et en Île-de-France, puis réservez-le dans la conversation.

VTC AEROPORT PARIS est une société de VTC en activité depuis 2016 : transferts entre Paris et les aéroports de Roissy-Charles-de-Gaulle (CDG), Orly, Beauvais et Le Bourget, les gares, les hôtels et Disneyland Paris, en voiture éco, berline, van 7 places ou limousine.

- Comparez les véhicules selon le nombre de passagers et de bagages.
- Confirmez l'adresse exacte de prise en charge.
- Obtenez le prix fixe de chaque véhicule pour une date et une heure données (heure de Paris), identique au site vtc-aeroport.fr.
- Réservez après avoir validé le récapitulatif ; payez à bord (carte ou espèces) ou en ligne via un lien sécurisé sur vtc-aeroport.fr.
- Suivez une réservation avec son numéro et votre e-mail.

Annulation ou modification : 06 42 24 92 47.
